text: Barbara's dad passed away on Sunday. The funeral is sometime next week, probably Thursday. I should send flowers to the house the day before. Her mum wants it small, just family and a few close friends, and they're asking for donations to the hospice instead of wreaths. Barbara is handling the eulogy and sounded completely wrung out on the phone.
Luis has his driving test at the end of the month. Third attempt, and he's really nervous about the roundabouts this time.
Pick up the dry cleaning before Friday and renew the car tax.

Camila and Bilal have split up after six years. She's staying with her sister Ines in Leeds for now. Check in with Camila over the weekend. Apparently he's keeping the flat and their dog Mochi, which she's more upset about than anything. She's got her first counselling session sometime next week and wants to go back to painting.
Vera got made redundant this morning. Whole department gone. She seems oddly calm about it, but her husband is worried sick.
Amir's piano audition for the conservatoire is in early March. He's been practising four hours a day. Don't forget to text him good luck that morning.
Miriam told me her grandmother died last month. She was 94. They were very close and Miriam is still finding it hard.
Kate's results day is next Thursday. She needs two As for Durham. Ask her how it went the day after.
Yosef is sitting his bar exams sometime over the summer. He's switching to part-time at the firm to revise.
Book the boiler service for early November. Also need to cancel the gym membership before the end of the month.

Fatima's brother Sunil was let go from the bank. He has a meeting with HR on Monday and then a week after that his notice period starts. Fatima says he's not sleeping. I must call Sunil before the meeting, and maybe take him for a pint afterwards.
Michael and Helen are going to his aunt's funeral in Cork on the 14th. They're flying out the night before.
Björn passed his theory test! First go. Practical is booked for sometime in January.
Meera's cat Biscuit was put to sleep yesterday. She's devastated. I should drop round with something the next day or so.
Oscar's audition for the youth orchestra got cancelled because the conductor is ill. They'll reschedule sometime in the spring.
Kavya has her nursing finals in late May. She hates exams and gets terrible migraines when she's stressed.
Ayo mentioned her uncle's memorial is at the end of the month. She's giving a reading and is nervous about getting through it.
Nina and her boyfriend Felix broke up last week. She seemed fine at lunch, honestly a bit relieved.
Joanna's son has his GCSE mocks the week after half term. He's into chess and wants a proper wooden set for Christmas.
Need to post the passport renewal form this week and get new photos done first.

Chen's grandfather is very ill in Shanghai. Chen is flying out sometime next week, depending on what the doctors say. Remind me to message him the day he lands. His wife Noor can't go because of work, so she'll be on her own with the twins. Maybe offer to take the kids to the park one afternoon while he's away.
Sofia passed her driving test this afternoon! She's been learning since spring. Send congrats and ask if she's buying a car.
Blessing failed her Grade 8 violin exam by two marks. She's retaking it in early March. She's pretty down about it.
Florin's company is making half the team redundant. He finds out whether he's affected at the end of the month. Don't forget to check in with him the day after.
Xavier went to his ex-wife's father's funeral yesterday. Awkward, but he said he was glad he went.

Kaito is doing his PhD viva sometime in the first week of December. His supervisor, Dr Olsen, thinks he's ready, but Kaito keeps saying he isn't. He's barely eating and has stopped coming to climbing. His girlfriend Kavya says he rehearses answers in his sleep. Text him the night before and suggest a proper celebration the week after.
Anil and Noor lost their dog Pepper last weekend. Noor cried the whole time we talked. Anil's mum is staying with them for a while.
Barbara mentioned the headstone is going up in early spring and they'll have a small gathering afterwards. I'm going.
Camila's audition for the National Youth Theatre is a week after her birthday, so late April. I need to ask what monologue she picked.
Car MOT due end of November. Ring the garage.
Luis passed! Two minors. He's taking his mum to the coast in his brother's car to celebrate the weekend after.
Ines's partner left her quite suddenly. She's moving back in with her parents over the summer. She doesn't want to talk about it much.

Bilal's redundancy consultation is on Wednesday. He's asked me to look over his CV beforehand. I should send it back by Tuesday night. He's thinking about retraining as a teacher, maybe starting a PGCE early next year. His wife is supportive but they've just had a baby, so money is tight and he's quietly panicking.
Vera has a job interview the week after next, her first since the redundancy. She's terrified of interviews.
Amir's grandma, Mrs Khan, passed away. Funeral is tomorrow morning at the mosque, burial straight after. I'll go to the house the day after.
Kate wants to be a vet. She's volunteering at the animal shelter on Saturdays.

Helen's mum has her driving assessment after the stroke sometime next month. Helen's anxious, her mum less so. I should ask Helen how it went afterwards. If her mum fails, she loses her licence, and she lives miles from the nearest shop. Helen is already looking at bus routes just in case. Her brother Michael is driving up from Cardiff to take her.
Sort out the recycling bins, buy stamps and return the library books before they're overdue on the 3rd.
Michael's A-level son Oscar got his results: three A stars. Off to Edinburgh to study physics in September. Michael was beaming.

Talked to Miriam for ages on the phone. Her divorce comes through sometime in the new year. She's moving to Bristol a few weeks after that, and her daughter starts a new school there in the spring term. She says she's ready for a fresh start but sounds exhausted. Her ex is being difficult about the house. I want to send her something nice when the paperwork is done, maybe that candle shop she likes.
Yosef said his father's yahrzeit is next week. He lights a candle every year. Don't need to do anything, just be aware.
Fatima's cousin Meera is sitting her medical school interviews over the next few weeks. Meera hates public speaking. Remind me to send her some practice questions.
Björn Jensen from work is leaving at the end of the month after the restructure. Leaving drinks on the last Friday. Must chip in for his card.
Kavya got her results. She passed everything, including pharmacology, which she was dreading.
Ayo got through the reading at the memorial. She said her aunt hugged her afterwards and that meant a lot. I should check how she's doing next week.

Felix is retaking his accountancy exams in early March, the week after his sister Joanna's wedding. Not ideal timing. He's revising on the train every morning. Ask Felix sometime in February whether he wants to borrow my old notes.

Nina's grandad, everyone calls him Pops, died peacefully on Tuesday. Funeral is the end of next week at the crematorium in Hove. Nina is organising most of it because her mum isn't coping. I need to send a card and ask Nina if she needs help with the food for the wake.
Return the faulty kettle to Argos and pick up a birthday card for Saturday.
Chen's grandfather died the day after Chen arrived. At least he got there in time. He'll be back in a fortnight.

Sofia's dad, Florin Moreau, was made redundant after 22 years at the plant. Sofia says he's taking it hard and won't leave the house. Her mum wants him to see someone. She asked me not to mention it to him directly.
Blessing's little brother has his eleven-plus sometime in September. Their mum is doing practice papers with him every evening.
Xavier passed his citizenship test. Ceremony is sometime next month. Should get him a little something, he mentioned wanting a decent fountain pen.
Weekend plan: Saturday morning dentist, then the tip with the old mattress, then the big shop. Sunday is for batch cooking.
Kaito's viva went well, minor corrections only. Dr Olsen took him out for dinner afterwards. I should congratulate him properly when I see him on Friday.

Noor told me she and Anil are separating. They're telling the kids this weekend and Anil is moving out a week after. Noor is holding it together for the children, but she's struggling. Their daughter has her SATs in May, which Noor is worried about. Remind me to call Noor on Sunday evening.
Barbara's granddaughter Camila sits her grade 5 ballet exam the morning after the school play. She's a bundle of nerves about both.
Luis's boss told him his contract won't be renewed when it ends in early March. He's applying for jobs in Madrid over the summer.
Meera passed her medical school interviews and got an offer from Leeds! Wish her well and ask when she finds out about the others.
Haven't heard from Helen since the funeral last Saturday. I should text her sometime this week, nothing heavy, just to say I'm thinking of her.
Amir got into the conservatoire. Starts in September. His mum is already planning a party for sometime over the summer.
